Suggests switching to UWP solely to get Acrylic in a new desktop app.
acceptable_alternatives: Use the older `DesktopAcrylicController`/`MicaController` composition-controller pattern if the answer targets Windows App SDK 1.1 or 1.2.
Use `MicaBackdrop` instead of `DesktopAcrylicBackdrop` if the developer accepts Mica for the main window.
Use Acrylic only on transient UI such as flyouts and use Mica for the base window.
